program.name: Shoulder EMOM
program.subject: Shoulders
program.blurb: Shoulders on the minute every day: presses, raises, traps and rotator-cuff work in rotation.
program.about: Shoulders every day, on the clock. Each minute starts a press, a raise, a trap move or a rotator-cuff move, and the rest of the minute is recovery. The two days change the order and swap the traps for the triceps, so the shoulder gets worked from every side. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
